items.title: Watch: Wildfire seen near Reno as tens of thousands told to evacuate
items.dek: Thousands of people in the US state of Nevada have been warned to evacuate as the wildfire continues to spread in the outskirts of Reno.

items.title: Nearly 90,000 told to evacuate as wildfire approaches Reno, Nevada
items.dek: The fire has burned around 10,500 acres and is completely uncontained, officials say.
